services.heroSubtitle: I'm Phuc — a final-year software student helping small shops, personal brands and beginners get a website that looks professional, builds trust and brings in customers, at a price that won't hurt. You don't need to know anything technical — just tell me your goal and I'll handle the rest. Clear pricing from the start, and you review a preview before deciding.

guarantees.title: Free advice & quote
guarantees.desc: Message me first and get a clear all-in quote — no deposit needed yet and no hidden fees later.

guarantees.title: Preview before you commit

guarantees.title: Support after handover

services.processHeading: A lean process you can always follow
workingSteps: You message your needs, share your current site or describe an idea — free, no commitment.
I advise on the approach and quote a price that fits your budget.
We agree on scope, timeline and a small deposit to start; you track progress step by step.
Full handover with a usage guide and support for small tweaks after you receive the site.
services.closingNote: Not sure where to start? Just send me your current goal or the site you already have, and I'll suggest the leanest option within your budget — even if all you need is one simple page. Not tech-savvy? No worries, I've got that part covered. Want to be sure first? Feel free to check out the projects I've already built.
services.closingCta: Message me for a free consultation

landing.name: One-page landing
landing.description: Ideal when you need a single, striking page to showcase a product, event, personal CV or run ads — fast, focused and the lightest on cost.
landing.note: The most affordable way to get online in just a few days.
features: Visitors instantly get what you offer and tap to call or order, instead of leaving to look elsewhere
Clean and beautiful on mobile, so customers reach you with a single tap
Paste the link on Facebook or Zalo and it shows an eye-catching image and title, so more people click
Later you can update prices, photos and phone number yourself — no code, no paid callbacks

website.name: Multi-page website
website.description: For small shops, cafés, personal brands or services that need a complete multi-page website (about, services, contact...) to look professional and sell better.
website.note: Price depends on the number of pages, features and content you need — confirmed clearly before we start.
features: Your shop or service looks professional and trustworthy, on par with the big brands
Customers find information and order on their own, so you stop repeating the same answers
A chance to show up when people search your service on Google, instead of only your competitors
Easy to expand later with more pages or online sales — no need to rebuild from scratch

dynamic.name: Website with dynamic features
dynamic.description: When you need more than a brochure site: sign-up / booking forms, member login, a content admin area, or a connection to your existing system or API.
dynamic.note: Price depends on how many features you need and how complex they are; projects with payments, a dashboard or multiple user roles typically run 12–20 million VND. I'll break it down clearly before quoting.
features: Customers sign up, book or send requests right on the site, with the info landing straight in your email or system
A login or admin area so you update content yourself, without calling a developer every time
Connects to the tools and data you already use (Google Sheets, APIs, existing systems...)
Built on solid tech (Next.js/React) to run reliably and add more features later

optimize.name: SEO & speed up an existing site
optimize.description: For a live Next.js/React website that loads slowly, breaks often, looks poor on mobile or can't rank on Google — I clean it up to be leaner, faster and more SEO-ready.
optimize.note: I optimize sites built with Next.js/React; cost depends on the current state and scope of work.
features: A faster, smoother site so customers aren't frustrated by waiting or glitches
Looks and works well on mobile, so a broken layout no longer costs you customers
Reworked titles, descriptions and speed so the site ranks better and pulls in free traffic
You get a clear report of what was improved and what to do next, in plain language

faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: A few common questions before starting a project.

items.title: How much does a website cost?
items.content: A one-page landing starts from 690,000₫, a multi-page website from 1,900,000₫, and a site with dynamic features (forms, login, admin, backend...) from 6,900,000₫. The final price depends on pages, features and complexity — I always confirm it clearly before starting, with no hidden fees.

items.title: You're a student — is the work reliable?
items.content: I'm a final-year software student taking on real projects to sharpen my skills. In exchange for the friendly price, you get a product built with modern tech and clean code, and I give it my all because it's part of my portfolio too. You're welcome to review demos and past work before deciding.

items.title: Can you build a site if I don't have a design?
items.content: Yes. Just describe your idea, your field or your goal. I'll advise on content structure, layout and the right approach.

items.title: Is the website SEO-optimized?
items.content: Yes. Sites are built with a search-friendly structure and support load-speed optimization, metadata, sitemap and the basic technical SEO factors.

items.title: Do you help with domain and hosting?
items.content: Yes. I can advise on or set up domain, hosting and related services if you don't have the infrastructure yet.

items.title: Is there support after handover?
items.content: Yes. After completion I still provide usage guidance, answer questions and handle bug fixes and small tweaks within the agreed scope.
